The report of the last enforcement

Source: R/apply.R
last_report.Rd

Every eval_safe(), run(), confine() and apply_policy() call that was given a policy records which layers it applied and which it skipped.

Usage

last_report()

Value

The most recent report (class lk_report), or NULL if no policy has been applied in this session.
